decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is a low-cost system component that the firm presented as a flagship, and it underpins its modular track lighting, so keeping this option open costs little and protects the platform.

This LED line is close to the core offer and cheap to keep, but four years after launch premium LED models are often superseded, so there is a moderate chance it gets pruned in favour of the newer families E and F.
The home automation server box anchors the firm's smart home direction, and that market is still uncertain, so retaining the option has strategic value despite possible hardware generation changes.
The luminaire family had a dedicated page and is close to the core business, so maintenance costs are low, though the firm's broad portfolio and newer launches raise a moderate risk of replacement.
